content.title: Prudential Poised for Growth in All Markets, CEO Says
content.description: Prudential Plc's new business profit grew in the first half of the year, thanks to buoyant demand in markets from Hong Kong to Indonesia. CEO Anil Wadhwani tells "Bloomberg: The China Show" that the results underscore the strength of the company's business model. He also says Prudential's capital strength gives it opportunity to grow in all its key markets.
